source_policy: Observed color values below are approximate digital stand-ins judged by eye from the named work; chosen values are implementation defaults, not sampled source pixels.

game.void.role: Deep indigo stage/background for the game-world direction.
game.void.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slides 1–9; approximate by eye.
game.void.reason: A digital stand-in for the repeated dark indigo field.

game.lavender.role: Light dialogue window and title panel.
game.lavender.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slide 1; approximate by eye.
game.lavender.reason: Reproduces the pale violet window while preserving a strong dark-text pairing.

game.sunflower.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slides 8–9 and 12–20; approximate by eye.
game.sunflower.reason: Stands in for the deck's bright yellow panels.

game.ink.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slides 8–9 and 14; approximate by eye.
game.ink.reason: Provides a near-black outline and a checked high-contrast text color.

game.paper.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slides 1 and 7; approximate by eye.
game.paper.reason: A soft-white stand-in for the title and transition lettering.

game.pink.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slides 1, 8–9 and 11–12; approximate by eye.
game.pink.reason: Keeps the vivid pink accent available for non-text details.

game.cyan.role: Decorative pixel accent and small diagrams.
game.cyan.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slides 3 and 6; approximate by eye.
game.cyan.reason: Provides a cool counter-accent visible against indigo.

game.violet.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slides 1, 8–9 and 11–12; approximate by eye.
game.violet.reason: Echoes the blue-violet shadow pixels in decorative assets.

game.green.role: Small ground or pixel prop accent.
game.green.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, slides 8–9 and 14; approximate by eye.
game.green.reason: Represents the green pixel ground as a minor accent, not a second dominant field.

space.field.role: Dark star-field background in the poster direction.
space.field.source: Space Race poster, single-page composition; approximate by eye.
space.field.reason: A practical stand-in for the poster's deep teal-green field.

space.copper.source: Space Race poster, single-page composition; approximate by eye.
space.copper.reason: Represents the warm thin line work; reserve for ornament rather than small text.

space.cream.role: Poster title and high-value focal highlight.
space.cream.source: Space Race poster, single-page composition; approximate by eye.
space.cream.reason: Stands in for the cream title and moonlight.

space.ground.role: Mauve-charcoal ground below the space scene.
space.ground.source: Space Race poster, single-page composition; approximate by eye.
space.ground.reason: Represents the muted lower plane and supports cream lettering.

contrast_pairs.use: Body and display text on the indigo stage.
Body and display text inside yellow content panels.
Text inside the pale title window.
Yellow arrows and emphasis text on the indigo stage.
Optional indigo title text inside the pale title window.
Poster title and labels on the dark field.
Poster title on the muted ground.

display.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, pixel display headings on slides 1, 7–9; family unavailable in the supplied file's source listing.
display.reason: A local monospace approximation; Menlo/Monaco are macOS options and Courier New/monospace provide broad web fallbacks.

heading.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, rounded geometric section lettering on slides 8–9 and 14.
heading.reason: A system-friendly geometric sans stack with macOS and web fallbacks.

body.source: Prompt-engineer submission deck, body text; Poppins identified in the first read.
body.reason: Avenir Next is the available macOS rendering face; Avenir, Poppins when available, Arial and sans-serif are fallbacks for web use. Poppins is the face noted in the first read, but the renderer did not have it.

caption.reason: Readable small labels at 1920×1080; owner deck labels are small.

body-small.reason: Compact supporting copy while keeping presentation text legible.

body.reason: Generous default for explanatory slide copy.

hero.reason: Single title-slide statement; not for paragraphs.

tight.reason: Avoids clipped glyphs in large monospace display lettering.

heading.reason: Comfortable heading wrap with room for ascenders and descenders.

regular.reason: Default weight for readable explanatory copy.

display.reason: Keeps monospace display labels open at large sizes.

square.source: Prompt-engineer deck, yellow content panels on slides 9 and 14.

panel.source: Prompt-engineer deck, pale title window on slide 1; approximate by eye.

pill.source: Prompt-engineer deck, theme badge on slide 1.

duration.instant.reason: Static exports show no actual animation timing.

duration.short.reason: Starter for a minor interface response; confirm with owner.

duration.medium.reason: Starter for a simple reveal or emphasis; confirm with owner.

duration.long.reason: Starter for a scene-level transition only when it supports the message; confirm with owner.

easing.linear.reason: Neutral timing for continuous progress or pixel-like movement.

easing.enter.reason: Gentle ease-out starter for entrances; confirm with owner.

easing.exit.reason: Quick ease-in starter for exits; confirm with owner.

stroke.pixel.reason: Approximates the heavy pixel-art panel outline.

pixel.step.reason: A deliberate block size for CSS-built accents.

panel.title.width.reason: Keeps title text prominent with visible stage margins.

panel.title.height.reason: Leaves room for edge props and title metadata.

panel.content.width.reason: Provides three readable content modules at 1920×1080.

panel.content.height.reason: Keeps the focal panel below half the frame area.

grid.columns.reason: Three-step sequence for the content sample.
